description: This file defines the internal class ClientMessageCenter, which manages client-side message handling, connections, and communication with gateways in the Orleans distributed virtual actor system. It handles connection establishment, message dispatching, connection lifecycle events, and request ordering via buckets.

classes.name: ClientMessageCenter
classes.description: Handles client messaging, connection management, message dispatch, and gateway interactions in Orleans. Manages connection buckets for ordering, starts/stops connections, dispatches messages locally or via gateways, and maintains connection lifecycle events.

methods.name: StartAsync
methods.description: Establishes initial connection to gateways and marks the message center as running.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the message center, disconnects from gateways.

methods.name: DispatchLocalMessage
methods.description: Invokes the local message handler for a message.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message via the appropriate gateway connection, establishing connection if needed, with retry and error handling.

methods.name: RegisterLocalMessageHandler
methods.description: Sets the callback for handling local messages.

methods.name: RejectMessage
methods.description: Rejects a message, logging reason, and optionally creating and dispatching a rejection response.

methods.name: OnGatewayConnectionOpen
methods.description: Increments gateway connection count and notifies listeners when a new gateway connection is opened.

methods.name: OnGatewayConnectionClosed
methods.description: Decrements gateway connection count, notifies listeners, and detects cluster connection loss.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes resources, particularly the gateway manager.
